recognitionRules: Use Impact for the digest masthead and Gill Sans for reading text.
Keep issue number, date and first-read context above the story.
Use purple bands with white section labels and purple source links to distinguish New Evidence from Decision & Follow-through; keep Impact headlines black.
Give follow-through an owner, action and status rather than a vague closing recommendation.

writingLinks.reason: Leads with what changed and keeps delivery separate from measured outcomes.

quote: Read the update. Keep the record. Know who moves next.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use THE RESEARCH DIGEST as an Impact masthead with a small Gill Sans issue line. No news icon.
invariants: Use Impact for the digest masthead and Gill Sans for reading text.
Keep issue number, date and first-read context above the story.
Use purple bands with white section labels and purple source links to distinguish New Evidence from Decision & Follow-through; keep Impact headlines black.
adaptations: A short edition may include one finding and one action.
Archive pages retain issue dates and source identifiers.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
